paragraphs.text: Faithful is the saying, If a man seeketh the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
paragraphs.original: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος· εἴ τις ἐπισκοπῆς ὀρέγεται, καλοῦ ἔργου ἐπιθυμεῖ.
paragraphs.translit: Pistos ho logos· ei tis episkopēs oregetai, kalou ergou epithymei.

paragraphs.text: The bishop therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sober-minded, orderly, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
paragraphs.original: δεῖ οὖν τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνεπίλημπτον εἶναι, μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρα, νηφάλιον, σώφρονα, κόσμιον, φιλόξενον, διδακτικόν,
paragraphs.translit: dei oun ton episkopon anepilēmpton einai, mias gynaikos andra, nēphalion, sōphrona, kosmion, philoxenon, didaktikon,

paragraphs.text: no brawler, no striker; but gentle, not contentious, no lover of money;
paragraphs.original: μὴ πάροινον, μὴ πλήκτην, ἀλλὰ ἐπιεικῆ, ἄμαχον, ἀφιλάργυρον,
paragraphs.translit: mē paroinon, mē plēktēn, alla epieikē, amachon, aphilargyron,

paragraphs.text: one that ruleth well his own house, having [his] children in subjection with all gravity;
paragraphs.original: τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου καλῶς προϊστάμενον, τέκνα ἔχοντα ἐν ὑποταγῇ μετὰ πάσης σεμνότητος·
paragraphs.translit: tou idiou oikou kalōs proistamenon, tekna echonta en hypotagē meta pasēs semnotētos·

paragraphs.text: (but if a man knoweth not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
paragraphs.original: (εἰ δέ τις τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου προστῆναι οὐκ οἶδεν, πῶς ἐκκλησίας θεοῦ ἐπιμελήσεται;)
paragraphs.translit: (ei de tis tou idiou oikou prostēnai ouk oiden, pōs ekklēsias theou epimelēsetai;)

paragraphs.text: not a novice, lest being puffed up he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
paragraphs.original: μὴ νεόφυτον, ἵνα μὴ τυφωθεὶς εἰς κρίμα ἐμπέσῃ τοῦ διαβόλου.
paragraphs.translit: mē neophyton, hina mē typhōtheis eis krima empesē tou diabolou.

paragraphs.text: Moreover he must have good testimony from them that are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
paragraphs.original: δεῖ δὲ καὶ μαρτυρίαν καλὴν ἔχειν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔξωθεν, ἵνα μὴ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν ἐμπέσῃ καὶ παγίδα τοῦ διαβόλου.
paragraphs.translit: dei de kai martyrian kalēn echein apo tōn exōthen, hina mē eis oneidismon empesē kai pagida tou diabolou.

paragraphs.text: Deacons in like manner [must be] grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
paragraphs.original: Διακόνους ὡσαύτως σεμνούς, μὴ διλόγους, μὴ οἴνῳ πολλῷ προσέχοντας, μὴ αἰσχροκερδεῖς,
paragraphs.translit: Diakonous hōsautōs semnous, mē dilogous, mē oinō pollō prosechontas, mē aischrokerdeis,

paragraphs.text: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
paragraphs.original: ἔχοντας τὸ μυστήριον τῆς πίστεως ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει.
paragraphs.translit: echontas to mystērion tēs pisteōs en kathara syneidēsei.

paragraphs.text: And let these also first be proved; then let them serve as deacons, if they be blameless.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὗτοι δὲ δοκιμαζέσθωσαν πρῶτον, εἶτα διακονείτωσαν ἀνέγκλητοι ὄντες.
paragraphs.translit: kai houtoi de dokimazesthōsan prōton, eita diakoneitōsan anenklētoi ontes.

paragraphs.text: Women in like manner [must be] grave, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.
paragraphs.original: γυναῖκας ὡσαύτως σεμνάς, μὴ διαβόλους, νηφαλίους, πιστὰς ἐν πᾶσιν.
paragraphs.translit: gynaikas hōsautōs semnas, mē diabolous, nēphalious, pistas en pasin.

paragraphs.text: Let deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling [their] children and their own houses well.
paragraphs.original: διάκονοι ἔστωσαν μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρες, τέκνων καλῶς προϊστάμενοι καὶ τῶν ἰδίων οἴκων·
paragraphs.translit: diakonoi estōsan mias gynaikos andres, teknōn kalōs proistamenoi kai tōn idiōn oikōn·

paragraphs.text: For they that have served well as deacons gain to themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: οἱ γὰρ καλῶς διακονήσαντες βαθμὸν ἑαυτοῖς καλὸν περιποιοῦνται καὶ πολλὴν παρρησίαν ἐν πίστει τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hoi gar kalōs diakonēsantes bathmon heautois kalon peripoiountai kai pollēn parrēsian en pistei tē en Christō Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly;
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτά σοι γράφω, ἐλπίζων ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ ἐν τάχει,
paragraphs.translit: Tauta soi graphō, elpizōn elthein pros se en tachei,

paragraphs.text: but if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how men ought to behave themselves in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν δὲ βραδύνω, ἵνα εἰδῇς πῶς δεῖ ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ ἀναστρέφεσθαι, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐκκλησία θεοῦ ζῶντος, στῦλος καὶ ἑδραίωμα τῆς ἀληθείας·
paragraphs.translit: ean de bradynō, hina eidēs pōs dei en oikō theou anastrephesthai, hētis estin ekklēsia theou zōntos, stylos kai hedraiōma tēs alētheias·

paragraphs.text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness; He who was manifested in the flesh, Justified in the spirit, Seen of angels, Preached among the nations, Believed on in the world, Received up in glory.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὁμολογουμένως μέγα ἐστὶν τὸ τῆς εὐσεβείας μυστήριον· Ὃς ἐφανερώθη ἐν σαρκί, ἐδικαιώθη ἐν πνεύματι, ὤφθη ἀγγέλοις, ἐκηρύχθη ἐν ἔθνεσιν, ἐπιστεύθη ἐν κόσμῳ, ἀνελήμφθη ἐν δόξῃ.
paragraphs.translit: kai homologoumenōs mega estin to tēs eusebeias mystērion· Hos ephanerōthē en sarki, edikaiōthē en pneumati, ōphthē angelois, ekērychthē en ethnesin, episteuthē en kosmō, anelēmphthē en doxē.
